dossier_meta.catalog_title: Classification of planar graphs by cop number
dossier_meta.statement_text: Classify which planar graphs have cop number $i$, for $1 \leq i \leq 3$.
dossier_meta.context_text: By Theorem 1, every connected planar graph has cop number 1, 2, or 3. Cop-win graphs are precisely the dismantlable ones, which may eventually aid in classifying planar cop-win graphs, but a complete classification for all three cop number values remains open.
